title: GitHub - ats4321/walsh: A repository for walsh
excerpt: A repository for walsh. Contribute to ats4321/walsh development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
Walsh is a multi-agent stock research system that routes each ticker through four specialized agents in parallel — Fundamental, Technical, Sentiment, and Macro — aggregates their theses via a confidence-weighted Portfolio Manager, then gates the final call through a Rule-Based Risk Manager that can veto or downgrade before any trade is executed.

Live demo: walsh-demo.vercel.app · Demo GIF

Results

Backtest run: AAPL · MSFT · NVDA, Jan 2023 – Dec 2023, $100k initial capital, rule-based signal agents, strict no-lookahead enforcement.

Metric Walsh Pipeline Buy & Hold (equal-weight)
Total Return +75.52% +119.75%
Sharpe Ratio 2.36 2.86
Max Drawdown −13.50% −13.22%
Win Rate 76.2% —
# Trades 21 —
Final Value $175,518 $219,749

Walsh underperformed buy-and-hold on this bull-market period. In Oct 2023, the pipeline exited all positions when momentum signals broke down and held cash for the entire month, missing a subsequent NVDA recovery rally. This is the intended behavior of the risk gate — it correctly identified a high-uncertainty period — but reveals the cost of a conservative threshold in trending markets.

Per-agent accuracy / confidence calibration: pending. The eval/agent_attribution.py module is ready; results require ≥50 completed pipeline runs with follow-up price data to produce meaningful calibration curves.

Cost and latency per run: pending. The eval/cost_latency.py PipelineTracker is instrumented; numbers will be populated once the LLM-backed agents replace the current rule-based stubs.

Adversarial robustness: 18 test cases across three agent types; 5 flagged for overconfidence (see Known limitations).

Architecture

                          ┌──────────────────────────┐
          ticker ──────►  │      Orchestrator         │
                          │   (asyncio.gather)        │
                          └──┬──┬──┬──┬──────────────┘
                             │  │  │  │  (parallel)
               ┌─────────────┘  │  │  └─────────────┐
               ▼                ▼  ▼                 ▼
        ┌────────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌───────────┐
        │Fundamental │  │Technical │  │Sentiment │  │  Macro    │
        │  Analyst   │  │ Analyst  │  │ Analyst  │  │  Analyst  │
        │            │  │          │  │          │  │           │
        │PE, growth, │  │RSI, MACD,│  │news,     │  │GDP, rates,│
        │margins,    │  │golden    │  │social,   │  │inflation, │
        │D/E ratio   │  │cross     │  │insider   │  │sector     │
        └─────┬──────┘  └────┬─────┘  └────┬─────┘  └─────┬─────┘
              └──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────┘
                                     │
                                     ▼  AgentThesis × 4
                          ┌──────────────────────┐
                          │   Portfolio Manager  │
                          │ confidence-weighted  │
                          │  signal synthesis    │
                          └──────────┬───────────┘
                                     │  PortfolioDecision
                                     ▼
                          ┌──────────────────────┐
                          │    Risk Manager      │
                          │  veto / downgrade    │
                          │  • conf < 45% → veto │
                          │  • spread ≥ 4 → veto │
                          │  • conf < 65% →      │
                          │    downgrade STRONG  │
                          └──────────┬───────────┘
                                     │  FinalDecision
                                     ▼
                              approved / vetoed

How it works

Fundamental Analyst fetches valuation metrics (PE ratio, revenue growth, profit margin, debt-to-equity) and scores them against thresholds. A PE below 15 adds a bullish vote; above 30 adds a bearish one. Revenue growth above 15% or profit margins above 20% each add a bullish vote. The raw score maps to a STRONG_BUY / BUY / HOLD / SELL / STRONG_SELL signal with confidence proportional to conviction strength.

Technical Analyst evaluates SMA crossovers (20d and 50d), MACD histogram direction, and optionally a golden-cross flag. Each indicator votes +1 or −1, with a dead band to suppress spurious signals on flat prices. In the backtest harness, the rule-based TechnicalSignalAgent uses realized momentum over 20d and 50d rolling windows against yfinance price data.

Sentiment Analyst aggregates a news sentiment score (−1 to +1) and a social sentiment score, averages them, then applies an insider-buying bonus. Outputs a directional signal and a confidence value dampened for near-neutral sentiment.

Macro Analyst checks GDP growth, the Fed Funds rate, inflation, and a sector outlook tag. Favorable macro conditions (growth > 2.5%, rate < 4%, inflation < 3%, bullish sector) each add a bullish vote; unfavorable conditions subtract. The macro signal acts as a regime filter — a strong bearish macro can offset bullish technical or sentiment readings.

Portfolio Manager synthesizes the four theses using a confidence-weighted average of their numeric signal scores. Consensus penalty: confidence is scaled down by the spread between the highest and lowest agent signals (conf × max(0.5, 1 − spread × 0.1)). A tight consensus stays near full confidence; a 4-point spread (STRONG_BUY vs STRONG_SELL) halves it.

Risk Manager is the only decision-maker. Two hard veto rules: (1) portfolio confidence below 45% → forced HOLD regardless of signal, (2) agent signal spread ≥ 4 → veto as extreme disagreement. A soft rule downgrades STRONG_BUY → BUY or STRONG_SELL → SELL when confidence is 45–65%. If no rule fires, the decision is passed through with "No risk flags."

Known limitations / failure modes

Backtest underperformance (Jan–Dec 2023): Walsh's rule-based backtest returned +75.5% vs +119.8% for equal-weight passive buy-and-hold on AAPL/MSFT/NVDA — underperforming by ~44 pp. The primary cause is the volatility damper (vol_cap=40% in backtest/engine.py) which zeroed out NVDA allocation for most of the year (NVDA realized vol was ~70-90%), combined with the MeanReversionSignalAgent issuing SELL signals on stocks hitting 52-week highs throughout the bull run. Signal weighting and the vol cap need tuning before this strategy is suitable for live deployment. More broadly, contrarian strategies structurally underperform during sustained trending regimes — a more robust Walsh would detect trend vs. mean-reverting market conditions and scale the MeanReversionSignalAgent's weight accordingly, rather than holding it constant across all regimes.

Backtest methodology clarification: The backtest engine uses deterministic rule-based agents (SMA crossover, momentum, mean-reversion) — not the LLM-powered agents shown in the demo dashboard. The numbers above reflect the algorithmic signal engine only.

These are documented findings from eval/adversarial.py (18 test cases, 5 flagged):

TECH_003 — Zigzag prices, overconfidence (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.65) SMA signals from oscillating prices cancel imperfectly; the agent still returns 0.80 because the vote mean slightly favors one side. A price series that crosses SMA20/SMA50 repeatedly should produce near-zero confidence, but the dead band (0.1%) is too tight to suppress all noise.

TECH_004 — Crash after uptrend, stale bullish signal (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.65) When prices run up then crash sharply, SMA20 and SMA50 lag by construction. The agent may still read "price above SMA" for several bars after the crash top, giving a confident BUY into a falling market. The 20d momentum partially corrects this but cannot always overcome two SMA votes.

TECH_006 — Single-day 50% jump after flat history, spurious signal (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.75) A one-day spike inflates the 20d momentum calculation and pushes price above both SMAs immediately, generating a STRONG_BUY at 0.80 confidence despite no trend substance. Input validation (e.g., cap single-bar moves) is not currently applied.

MOM_005 — Negative prices (data corruption), overconfident (confidence=0.85, max expected 0.65) MomentumSignalAgent does not validate that prices are positive before computing log-returns. Negative prices produce a defined (if nonsensical) momentum value and a confident directional signal. A price sanity check is the fix.

REV_006 — Zigzag mid-range, overconfident (confidence=0.76, max expected 0.50) MeanReversionSignalAgent sees the price oscillating exactly in the middle of its 52-week range (no reversion signal), yet outputs 0.76 confidence. The agent currently gives a non-zero confidence for mid-range prices when it should default to "no clear reversion target."

Structural limitations not yet tested:

  • The Risk Manager's 45% confidence threshold is a single hard cutoff; it doesn't account for drawdown regime or portfolio concentration.
  • Agent signals are computed independently with no cross-agent information sharing — a macro veto doesn't lower a technical agent's confidence.
  • The current backtest uses rule-based stub agents; LLM-backed agents (which can hallucinate or overstate certainty) will likely surface additional failure modes.
  • No live market data integration; the orchestrator points to a mock API (api.finance.example.com).

Demo

Live dashboard at demo-cyan-delta.vercel.app

The dashboard shows 5 pre-generated ticker runs selectable via dropdown, each illustrating a distinct pipeline outcome:

Ticker Story
AAPL All four agents agree → BUY, approved
MSFT Extreme disagreement (Fundamental=SELL vs Technical=STRONG_BUY) → vetoed
NVDA All four agents strongly agree → STRONG_BUY, approved
TSLA Agent split: Fundamental=BUY vs Technical=SELL (180° opposition) → vetoed, no position
META Agents agree (STRONG_BUY consensus) but Risk Manager vetoes due to 76% annualized volatility exceeding the 40% risk cap

Terminal reproduction (no GIF yet — recording pending):

# Run the orchestrator against mock data for MSFT:
cd demo
python3 gen_demo.py  # outputs the same JSON as demo/data/MSFT.json

To record the GIF once the LLM-backed pipeline is wired:

pip install vhs
vhs scripts/record_pipeline.tape  # not yet authored

Setup

Prerequisites

  • Python 3.11+
  • uv or pip
  • An Anthropic API key (for the LLM-backed agents; not required for the backtest harness)

Install

# Backtest / eval harness (walsh-backtest-eval-harness branch)
pip install -e ".[dev]"          # installs yfinance, pydantic, pytest

# Orchestrator (commit-and-push-all-changes branch)
pip install -r requirements.txt  # installs httpx

Environment variables

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...   # required for LLM-backed agents

The backtest engine and adversarial eval do not call the Anthropic API.

Run the backtest

python -m backtest.engine --tickers AAPL,MSFT,NVDA --start 2023-01-01 --end 2024-01-01
# Results written to eval/results/<timestamp>_backtest.json
# Agent theses appended to eval/results/theses.jsonl

Run the eval suite

# Adversarial robustness (no external deps required)
python -m eval.adversarial

# Per-agent accuracy (requires theses.jsonl from a backtest run)
python -m eval.agent_attribution

# Cost / latency (requires an instrumented pipeline run)
python -m eval.cost_latency

Run the full orchestrator pipeline

python -m orchestrator.main AAPL    # outputs FinalDecision JSON to stdout

Tests

pytest                     # all tests
pytest tests/test_backtest.py -v
pytest tests/test_eval.py -v

Run the demo dashboard locally

cd demo
npm install
npm run dev               # http://localhost:3000

sentences.zh: Walsh 是一个多代理股票研究系统，它通过四个并行的专业代理（基本面、技术、情绪和宏观）对每个股票进行路由，通过置信加权投资组合经理汇总他们的论点，然后通过基于规则的风险管理器来控制最终的调用，该风险管理器可以在执行任何交易之前否决或降级。

sentences.zh: 原始分数映射为 STRONG_BUY / BUY / HOLD / SELL / STRONG_SELL 信号，置信度与信念强度成正比。

blocks.html_en: Technical Analyst evaluates SMA crossovers (20d and 50d), MACD histogram direction, and optionally a golden-cross flag. Each indicator votes +1 or −1, with a dead band to suppress spurious signals on flat prices. In the backtest harness, the rule-based TechnicalSignalAgent uses realized momentum over 20d and 50d rolling windows against yfinance price data.

sentences.en: Technical Analyst evaluates SMA crossovers (20d and 50d), MACD histogram direction, and optionally a golden-cross flag.
sentences.zh: 技术分析师评估 SMA 交叉（20 天和 50 天）、MACD 柱状图方向以及可选的金十字旗。

sentences.en: Each indicator votes +1 or −1, with a dead band to suppress spurious signals on flat prices.
sentences.zh: 每个指标都投票+1或-1，并有一个死区来抑制统一价格上的虚假信号。

sentences.en: In the backtest harness, the rule-based TechnicalSignalAgent uses realized momentum over 20d and 50d rolling windows against yfinance price data.
sentences.zh: 在回测工具中，基于规则的 TechnicalSignalAgent 使用针对 yfinance 价格数据的 20 天和 50 天滚动窗口实现的动量。

blocks.html_en: Sentiment Analyst aggregates a news sentiment score (−1 to +1) and a social sentiment score, averages them, then applies an insider-buying bonus. Outputs a directional signal and a confidence value dampened for near-neutral sentiment.

sentences.en: Sentiment Analyst aggregates a news sentiment score (−1 to +1) and a social sentiment score, averages them, then applies an insider-buying bonus.
sentences.zh: 情绪分析师汇总新闻情绪得分（−1 到 +1）和社会情绪得分，对它们进行平均，然后应用内部购买奖金。

sentences.en: Outputs a directional signal and a confidence value dampened for near-neutral sentiment.
sentences.zh: 输出方向信号和近中性情绪减弱的置信值。

blocks.html_en: Macro Analyst checks GDP growth, the Fed Funds rate, inflation, and a sector outlook tag. Favorable macro conditions (growth > 2.5%, rate < 4%, inflation < 3%, bullish sector) each add a bullish vote; unfavorable conditions subtract. The macro signal acts as a regime filter — a strong bearish macro can offset bullish technical or sentiment readings.

sentences.en: Macro Analyst checks GDP growth, the Fed Funds rate, inflation, and a sector outlook tag.
sentences.zh: 宏观分析师检查 GDP 增长、联邦基金利率、通货膨胀和行业前景标签。

sentences.en: Favorable macro conditions (growth > 2.5%, rate < 4%, inflation < 3%, bullish sector) each add a bullish vote; unfavorable conditions subtract.
sentences.zh: 有利的宏观条件（增长> 2.5％，利率< 4％，通货膨胀< 3％，看涨部门）每增加一票看涨票；不利条件减去。

sentences.en: The macro signal acts as a regime filter — a strong bearish macro can offset bullish technical or sentiment readings.
sentences.zh: 宏观信号起到了政权过滤器的作用——强劲的看跌宏观经济可以抵消看涨的技术或情绪读数。

blocks.html_en: Portfolio Manager synthesizes the four theses using a confidence-weighted average of their numeric signal scores. Consensus penalty: confidence is scaled down by the spread between the highest and lowest agent signals (conf × max(0.5, 1 − spread × 0.1)). A tight consensus stays near full confidence; a 4-point spread (STRONG_BUY vs STRONG_SELL) halves it.

sentences.en: Portfolio Manager synthesizes the four theses using a confidence-weighted average of their numeric signal scores.
sentences.zh: 投资组合管理器使用数字信号分数的置信加权平均值来综合这四个论文。

sentences.en: Consensus penalty: confidence is scaled down by the spread between the highest and lowest agent signals (conf × max(0.5, 1 − spread × 0.1)).
sentences.zh: 共识惩罚：置信度根据最高和最低代理信号之间的差值（conf × max(0.5, 1 − spread × 0.1)）而缩小。

sentences.en: A tight consensus stays near full confidence; a 4-point spread (STRONG_BUY vs STRONG_SELL) halves it.
sentences.zh: 紧密的共识接近完全的信心； 4 点价差（STRONG_BUY 与 STRONG_SELL）将其减半。

blocks.html_en: Risk Manager is the only decision-maker. Two hard veto rules: (1) portfolio confidence below 45% → forced HOLD regardless of signal, (2) agent signal spread ≥ 4 → veto as extreme disagreement. A soft rule downgrades STRONG_BUY → BUY or STRONG_SELL → SELL when confidence is 45–65%. If no rule fires, the decision is passed through with "No risk flags."

sentences.en: Risk Manager is the only decision-maker.
sentences.zh: 风险经理是唯一的决策者。

sentences.en: Two hard veto rules: (1) portfolio confidence below 45% → forced HOLD regardless of signal, (2) agent signal spread ≥ 4 → veto as extreme disagreement.
sentences.zh: 两条硬否决规则：(1) 投资组合置信度低于 45% → 无论信号如何均强制持有，(2) 代理信号传播≥ 4 → 作为极端分歧而否决。

sentences.en: A soft rule downgrades STRONG_BUY → BUY or STRONG_SELL → SELL when confidence is 45–65%.
sentences.zh: 当置信度为 45-65% 时，软规则会降级 STRONG_BUY → BUY 或 STRONG_SELL → SELL。

sentences.en: If no rule fires, the decision is passed through with "No risk flags."
sentences.zh: 如果没有规则触发，则决策将通过“无风险标志”。

sentences.en: Known limitations / failure modes
sentences.zh: 已知限制/故障模式

blocks.html_en: Backtest underperformance (Jan–Dec 2023): Walsh's rule-based backtest returned +75.5% vs +119.8% for equal-weight passive buy-and-hold on AAPL/MSFT/NVDA — underperforming by ~44 pp. The primary cause is the volatility damper (vol_cap=40% in backtest/engine.py) which zeroed out NVDA allocation for most of the year (NVDA realized vol was ~70-90%), combined with the MeanReversionSignalAgent issuing SELL signals on stocks hitting 52-week highs throughout the bull run. Signal weighting and the vol cap need tuning before this strategy is suitable for live deployment. More broadly, contrarian strategies structurally underperform during sustained trending regimes — a more robust Walsh would detect trend vs. mean-reverting market conditions and scale the MeanReversionSignalAgent's weight accordingly, rather than holding it constant across all regimes.

sentences.en: Backtest underperformance (Jan–Dec 2023): Walsh's rule-based backtest returned +75.5% vs +119.8% for equal-weight passive buy-and-hold on AAPL/MSFT/NVDA — underperforming by ~44 pp.
sentences.zh: 回测表现不佳（2023 年 1 月至 12 月）：Walsh 基于规则的回测回报率为 +75.5%，而 AAPL/MSFT/NVDA 等权重被动买入并持有的回报率为 +119.8% — 表现不佳约 44 个百分点。

sentences.en: The primary cause is the volatility damper (vol_cap=40% in backtest/engine.py) which zeroed out NVDA allocation for most of the year (NVDA realized vol was ~70-90%), combined with the MeanReversionSignalAgent issuing SELL signals on stocks hitting 52-week highs throughout the bull run.
sentences.zh: 主要原因是波动性阻尼器（backtest/engine.py 中的 vol_cap=40%）将 NVDA 分配在一年中的大部分时间归零（NVDA 实现的波动性约为 70-90%），再加上 MeanReversionSignalAgent 在整个牛市期间对触及 52 周高点的股票发出卖出信号。

sentences.en: Signal weighting and the vol cap need tuning before this strategy is suitable for live deployment.
sentences.zh: 在该策略适合实时部署之前，需要调整信号权重和波动率上限。

sentences.en: More broadly, contrarian strategies structurally underperform during sustained trending regimes — a more robust Walsh would detect trend vs. mean-reverting market conditions and scale the MeanReversionSignalAgent's weight accordingly, rather than holding it constant across all regimes.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，逆势策略在持续趋势状态下表现不佳——更强大的 Walsh 会检测趋势与均值回归的市场条件，并相应地调整 MeanReversionSignalAgent 的权重，而不是在所有状态下保持不变。

blocks.html_en: TECH_003 — Zigzag prices, overconfidence (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.65) SMA signals from oscillating prices cancel imperfectly; the agent still returns 0.80 because the vote mean slightly favors one side. A price series that crosses SMA20/SMA50 repeatedly should produce near-zero confidence, but the dead band (0.1%) is too tight to suppress all noise.

sentences.en: TECH_003 — Zigzag prices, overconfidence (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.65) SMA signals from oscillating prices cancel imperfectly; the agent still returns 0.80 because the vote mean slightly favors one side.

blocks.html_en: TECH_004 — Crash after uptrend, stale bullish signal (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.65) When prices run up then crash sharply, SMA20 and SMA50 lag by construction. The agent may still read "price above SMA" for several bars after the crash top, giving a confident BUY into a falling market. The 20d momentum partially corrects this but cannot always overcome two SMA votes.

sentences.en: TECH_004 — Crash after uptrend, stale bullish signal (confidence=0.80, max expected 0.65) When prices run up then crash sharply, SMA20 and SMA50 lag by construction.

Input validation (e.g., cap single-bar moves) is not currently applied.

content_html_zh:
Walsh 是一个多代理股票研究系统，它通过四个并行的专业代理（基本面、技术、情绪和宏观）对每个股票进行路由，通过置信加权投资组合经理汇总他们的论点，然后通过基于规则的风险管理器来控制最终的调用，该风险管理器可以在执行任何交易之前否决或降级。

现场演示：walsh-demo.vercel.app · 演示 GIF

结果

回测运行：AAPL·MSFT·NVDA，2023 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月，10 万美元初始资本，基于规则的信号代理，严格的无前瞻执行。

公制 沃尔什管道 买入并持有（等权重）
总回报 +75.52% +119.75%
夏普比率 2.36 2.86
最大回撤 −13.50% −13.22%
胜率 76.2% —
# 交易 21 —
最终值 $175,518 $219,749

沃尔什在本次牛市期间的表现逊色于买入并持有。 2023 年 10 月，当动能信号破裂时，该管道平仓了所有头寸，并在整个月内持有现金，错过了随后的 NVDA 复苏反弹。 这是风险门的预期行为——它正确地识别了一个高不确定性时期——但揭示了趋势市场中保守阈值的成本。

每个代理的准确性/置信度校准：待定。 eval/agent_attribution.py 模块已准备就绪；结果需要 ≥50 次完整的管道运行以及后续价格数据才能产生有意义的校准曲线。

每次运行的成本和延迟：待定。 eval/cost_latency.py PipelineTracker 已被检测；一旦LLM支持的代理取代当前基于规则的存根，数字就会被填充。

对抗稳健性：三种代理类型的 18 个测试用例； 5 被标记为过度自信（请参阅已知限制）。

                              approved / vetoed

它是如何运作的

基本面分析师获取估值指标（市盈率、收入增长、利润率、债务股本比）并根据阈值对其进行评分。 PE低于15增加了看涨投票；高于 30 则增加了看跌信号。 收入增长超过 15% 或利润率超过 20% 都会增加看涨票。 原始分数映射为 STRONG_BUY / BUY / HOLD / SELL / STRONG_SELL 信号，置信度与信念强度成正比。

技术分析师评估 SMA 交叉（20 天和 50 天）、MACD 柱状图方向以及可选的金十字旗。 每个指标都投票+1或-1，并有一个死区来抑制统一价格上的虚假信号。 在回测工具中，基于规则的 TechnicalSignalAgent 使用针对 yfinance 价格数据的 20 天和 50 天滚动窗口实现的动量。

情绪分析师汇总新闻情绪得分（−1 到 +1）和社会情绪得分，对它们进行平均，然后应用内部购买奖金。 输出方向信号和近中性情绪减弱的置信值。

宏观分析师检查 GDP 增长、联邦基金利率、通货膨胀和行业前景标签。 有利的宏观条件（增长> 2.5％，利率< 4％，通货膨胀< 3％，看涨部门）每增加一票看涨票；不利条件减去。 宏观信号起到了政权过滤器的作用——强劲的看跌宏观经济可以抵消看涨的技术或情绪读数。

投资组合管理器使用数字信号分数的置信加权平均值来综合这四个论文。 共识惩罚：置信度根据最高和最低代理信号之间的差值（conf × max(0.5, 1 − spread × 0.1)）而缩小。 紧密的共识接近完全的信心； 4 点价差（STRONG_BUY 与 STRONG_SELL）将其减半。

风险经理是唯一的决策者。 两条硬否决规则：(1) 投资组合置信度低于 45% → 无论信号如何均强制持有，(2) 代理信号传播≥ 4 → 作为极端分歧而否决。 当置信度为 45-65% 时，软规则会降级 STRONG_BUY → BUY 或 STRONG_SELL → SELL。 如果没有规则触发，则决策将通过“无风险标志”。

已知限制/故障模式

回测表现不佳（2023 年 1 月至 12 月）：Walsh 基于规则的回测回报率为 +75.5%，而 AAPL/MSFT/NVDA 等权重被动买入并持有的回报率为 +119.8% — 表现不佳约 44 个百分点。 主要原因是波动性阻尼器（backtest/engine.py 中的 vol_cap=40%）将 NVDA 分配在一年中的大部分时间归零（NVDA 实现的波动性约为 70-90%），再加上 MeanReversionSignalAgent 在整个牛市期间对触及 52 周高点的股票发出卖出信号。 在该策略适合实时部署之前，需要调整信号权重和波动率上限。 更广泛地说，逆势策略在持续趋势状态下表现不佳——更强大的 Walsh 会检测趋势与均值回归的市场条件，并相应地调整 MeanReversionSignalAgent 的权重，而不是在所有状态下保持不变。

回测方法说明：回测引擎使用基于规则的确定性代理（SMA 交叉、动量、均值回归），而不是演示仪表板中显示的由 LLM 驱动的代理。 上面的数字仅反映算法信号引擎。

这些是来自 eval/adversarial.py 的记录结果（18 个测试用例，5 个已标记）：

TECH_003 — 之字形价格，过度自信（置信度 = 0.80，最大预期 0.65）振荡价格的 SMA 信号完全取消；代理仍然返回 0.80，因为投票平均值稍微偏向一侧。 反复穿过 SMA20/SMA50 的价格系列应该会产生接近于零的置信度，但死区 (0.1%) 太窄而无法抑制所有噪音。

TECH_004 — 上升趋势后崩盘，看涨信号陈旧（置信度 = 0.80，最大预期 0.65） 当价格上涨然后急剧崩盘时，SMA20 和 SMA50 因构建而滞后。 在崩盘见顶后，经纪人可能仍将几根柱线的价格解读为“价格高于移动平均线”，从而在下跌的市场中给出自信的买入信号。 20 天的动量部分纠正了这一点，但并不总能克服两次 SMA 投票。

TECH_006 — 持平历史后单日上涨 50%，虚假信号（置信度 = 0.80，最大预期 0.75） 单日飙升会夸大 20 日动量计算，并将价格立即推至两条 SMA 之上，尽管没有趋势实质，但在 0.80 置信度下产生了 STRONG_BUY。 当前未应用输入验证（例如，限制单柱移动）。

MOM_005 — 负价格（数据损坏）、过度自信（置信度 = 0.85，最大预期 0.65） MomentumSignalAgent 在计算对数返回之前不会验证价格是否为正。 负价格产生明确的（如果无意义的）动量值和自信的方向信号。 价格健全性检查就是解决办法。

REV_006 — 之字形中档，过度自信（置信度 = 0.76，最大预期 0.50）MeanReversionSignalAgent 认为价格恰好在 52 周范围的中间振荡（无反转信号），但输出 0.76 置信度。 该代理商目前对中档价格给出非零信心，而应默认为“没有明确的回归目标”。

尚未测试的结构限制：

  • 风险管理器的 45% 置信阈值是单一硬截止；它没有考虑回撤制度或投资组合集中度。
  • 代理信号是独立计算的，没有跨代理信息共享——宏观否决不会降低技术代理的信心。
  • 当前的回测使用基于规则的存根代理； LLM 支持的代理（可能产生幻觉或夸大确定性）可能会出现其他故障模式。
  • 没有实时市场数据整合；协调器指向模拟 API (api.finance.example.com)。

# Backtest / eval harness (walsh-backtest-eval-harness branch)
pip install -e ".[dev]"          # installs yfinance, pydantic, pytest

pip install -r requirements.txt  # installs httpx

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...   # required for LLM-backed agents

回测引擎和对抗性评估不调用 Anthropic API。

python -m backtest.engine --tickers AAPL,MSFT,NVDA --start 2023-01-01 --end 2024-01-01
